  def calculate_glasses_count(image_path):
    # Convert the image to grayscale
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(image_path, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    
    # Perform thresholding
    _, thresh = cv2.threshold(gray, 0.35, 1.0, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
    
    # Detect the edges using Canny edge detection
    edges = cv2.Canny(thresh, 50, 150, 3)
    
    # Perform dilation to expand the detected object boundaries
    _, dilation = cv2.dilate(edges, None, iterations=2)
    
    # Perform erosion to contract the object boundaries
    _, erosion = cv2.erode(dilation, None, iterations=2)
    
    # Perform opening to increase the detection area
    kernel_size = 5
    opening = cv2.morphologyEx(erosion, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, np.ones((kernel_size, kernel_size), np.uint8))
    
    # Perform closing to further increase the detection area
    closing = cv2.morphologyEx(opening, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((kernel_size, kernel_size), np.uint8))

    people_count = 0
